# Enhanced Training Mode

This page discusses efforts to enhance training mode to add additional functionality.

## Chakra Settings

The following SEQ edit allows you to push left or right on the C-Stick to set the opponent's
chakra to 0% or 25% respectively:

```
game/game00.seq

SeqEdit
Name:
  C-Stick Sets Training Foe's Chakra
Offset:
  0x10F40
Position:
  0x15D20
Old Bytes:
  0x04037300000000283F00000000100000
New Bytes:
  0x0303000204037300000000283F000000004000000133000000015D540901027C00002224040242000000028C3F0000000000000004037300000000283F000000008000000133000000015D840901027C00002224040242000000028C3F000000000000000304000204037300000000283F00000000100000
New Bytes with branch back:
  0x0303000204037300000000283F000000004000000133000000015D540901027C00002224040242000000028C3F0000000000000004037300000000283F000000008000000133000000015D840901027C00002224040242000000028C3F000000000000000304000204037300000000283F000000001000000132000000010F50
Assembly:
push gpr2
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x400000
beqz label0
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x2224
i32_mov *gpr2->field_0x28C, 0x0
label0:
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x800000
beqz label1
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x2224
i32_mov *gpr2->field_0x28C, 0x0
label1:
pop gpr2
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x100000
```

If we wish to modify the current character, change `GAME_INFO->field_0x2224` to
`GAME_INFO->field_0x180`. The controller input is read from `PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28`
which is `SHARED_PRESSED_BUTTONS`.

And here's a version of the code where C-stick left reduces chakra by 25% and right
increases chakra by 25%.

```
game/game00.seq

SeqEdit
Name:
  C Stick Stuff
Offset:
  0x10F40
Position:
  0x15D20
Old Bytes:
  0x04037300000000283F00000000100000
New Bytes:
  0x0303000204037300000000283F000000004000000133000000015D540901027C00002224040842000000028C3F00000000000F0004037300000000283F000000008000000133000000015D840901027C00002224040742000000028C3F00000000000F000304000204037300000000283F00000000100000
New Bytes with branch back:
  0x0303000204037300000000283F000000004000000133000000015D540901027C00002224040842000000028C3F00000000000F0004037300000000283F000000008000000133000000015D840901027C00002224040742000000028C3F00000000000F000304000204037300000000283F000000001000000132000000010F50
Assembly:
push gpr2
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x400000
beqz label0
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x2224
i32_sub *gpr2->field_0x28C, 0xF00
label0:
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x800000
beqz label1
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x2224
i32_add *gpr2->field_0x28C, 0xF00
label1:
pop gpr2
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x100000
```

And then, a version where you can press Z to reduce yourself to 1 health:

```
game/game00.seq

SeqEdit
Name:
  C Stick Stuff
Offset:
  0x10F40
Position:
  0x15D20
Old Bytes:
  0x04037300000000283F00000000100000
New Bytes:
  
New Bytes with branch back:
  
Assembly:
push gpr2
push gpr3
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x400000
beqz label0
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x2224
i32_sub *gpr2->field_0x28C, 0xF00
label0:
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x800000
beqz label1
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x2224
i32_add *gpr2->field_0x28C, 0xF00
label1:
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x10
beqz label2
ptr_mov gpr2, GAME_INFO->field_0x180
i32_mov gpr3, *gpr2->field_0x27C
i32_mov *gpr2->field_0x260, gpr3
label2:
pop gpr2
pop gpr3
i32_andc PRIMARY_CONTROLLER->field_0x28, 0x100000

```

And last, a version where R + Z reduces your opponent's health to 1.
